items.title: India’s Property Sales Slow As 51% Of Firms Report Lower Festive Bookings
items.summary: India's property sales are experiencing a slowdown, with 51% of firms reporting lower festive bookings. This highlights cooling residential demand during what is traditionally the peak festive buying season.

items.title: Construction costs up 33%; Builders in Bengaluru face margin squeeze as sales slow down
items.summary: Bengaluru builders are facing a margin squeeze due to a 33% rise in construction costs alongside slowing sales. These cost pressures could impact project delivery and future property pricing.

items.title: Foreign investors return to lead India realty investments after 4 quarters
items.summary: Foreign investors have returned to lead Indian real estate investments after a four-quarter gap. This marks a significant rebound in overseas institutional confidence in the Indian property market.

items.title: Private Equity Invests $6.1 bn in Indian Real Estate in Nine Months
items.summary: Private equity inflows into Indian real estate reached $6.1 billion over a nine-month period. This demonstrates sustained institutional capital support for the sector over the broader year.

items.title: India’s real estate deal value falls 76% to USD 705 million in Q3 2026 as PE investment declines 35%
items.summary: India's real estate deal value fell 76% to $705 million in Q3 2026 as private equity investment dropped by 35%. Investors should note this sharp quarterly contraction in overall deal activity.

items.title: Mumbai ultra-luxury home sales above ₹50 crore more than double in Q2FY27: Report | Real Estate News
items.summary: Sales of ultra-luxury homes priced above ₹50 crore in Mumbai more than doubled in Q2 FY27. This indicates robust momentum and high liquidity at the topmost tier of the housing market.

items.title: India’s Real Estate Insolvency Trap. Builders Get A Second Chance, Homebuyers Get Another Delay. Is Insolvency Becoming An Escape Route From Accountability?
items.summary: Insolvency processes are increasingly giving developers a second chance while leaving homebuyers facing extended project delays. It highlights significant legal and delivery risks for property buyers navigating stalled developments.

items.title: TN RERA fines Emerald Haven ₹50,000 for collecting over 10% before registering sale agreement
items.summary: TN RERA penalized a developer ₹50,000 for collecting more than 10% of the cost before executing a registered sale agreement. This emphasizes strict regulatory enforcement of buyer advance-payment safeguards.

items.title: KREEVA plans ₹5,000 crore investment in luxury housing projects across Delhi-NCR, Tier-2 cities | Real Estate News
items.summary: KREEVA is planning a ₹5,000 crore investment in luxury housing projects across Delhi-NCR and Tier-2 cities. This signals a major upcoming pipeline of high-end residential supply across multiple markets.

items.title: Raymond Realty Q2: revenue up 7.5% YoY to ₹749 Cr as pre-sales surge 98% without new launches
items.summary: Raymond Realty posted a 7.5% YoY rise in Q2 revenue to ₹749 crore as pre-sales jumped 98% without any new launches. This reflects solid sales traction and buyer absorption from existing inventory.
